title: Am Tierpark, Berlin
description:
Close to Friedrichshain’s trendy neighborhood and yet in green surroundings, this brand new studio is located right next to Tierpark Friedrichsfelde in a very well-connected location.

APARTMENT
The bright studio is located on the 4th floor. 
The apartment is perfect for either a single or a couple. It will be fully furnished and equipped for comfortable living (incl. kitchen utensils, bed linens, and towels).

There will be a fast WiFi connection, as well as a dedicated workspace with a desk and chair, which will allow for the studio to be an efficient and convenient home-office working space.

The studio features floor-to-ceiling windows and a balcony with beautiful views of the greenery.

LOCATION
Nature and big-city charm in one: Lichtenberg combines the best of both worlds. There’s hardly any other part of the city where such contrasts harmonize as well as they do here. Right next to Friedrichsfelde Zoo and not far from Rummelsburger Bucht, the studio is situated in the east of Berlin in a green setting and yet in the heart of the capital.
If you enjoy sports and frequent outings into nature, Tierpark is right around the corner from your apartment building. You can purchase a yearly pass and enjoy the park whenever you like.
Grocery shopping is easy in this neighborhood. ALDI, Rewe, Rossmann, and MÄC-GEIZ are reachable within a 5-minute walk. Lidl, NETTO, and DM can be reached in 10-15 min by foot.
Friedrichsfelde offers a variety of cafés, restaurants, and bakeries all within walking distance of the apartment.
Weitlingkiez is a 7-min bike ride.
The hip Boxhagener Platz neighborhood is an easy 15-min bike ride away.

TRANSPORTATION
Tram (hidden) min by foot.
Bus 194 is 2 min by foot.
U-Bahn Station „Friedrichsfelde“ 7 min by foot.
S-Bahn Station „Friedrichsfelde Ost“ 12 min by foot.
BER Airport is 43 min by bus and train.

title: Zanderstraße, Berlin
description:
The flat is located on the ground floor and consists of 3 rooms, kitchen, bathroom and hallway and is heated with gas central heating. All rooms are equipped with floorboards.

In detail:
1.)    The room is approx. 23 sqm. It faces south and is very bright. The furnishings include a high-quality bed (140 *200) with bed base and various adjustment possibilities, a leather sofa (can also serve as a sleeping place for an additional 2 persons), several shelves and a TV. In the room there is an approx. 6 sqm storage area for suitcases, etc. hidden behind a curtain. Shutters in front of the window allow the room to be completely darkened. For friends of fast internet, CAT7 cables are laid in the entire flat, 4 fast Ethernet connections are located in this room.
2.)    Bathroom: Designer bathroom with underfloor heating and shower at ground level, washing machine.
3.)    Kitchen. Equipped with fitted kitchen, gas cooker, dishwasher and fridge, fully automatic coffee machine, toaster, kettle, crockery and cutlery.

Location: The flat is located in a villa area, so it is relatively quiet there, especially at night. Within a radius of one km you will find several shopping facilities (Aldi, Lidl, pharmacy, bakery, etc.).  You can also find pubs and snack bars there. There is a bus stop directly in front of the house, and the S-Bahn is about 5 minutes' walk away. The journey to Alexanderplatz by S-Bahn takes 23 minutes; by car it is usually quicker.

If you move in with 2 people, the rent increases by 150 € because of the additional costs (water, gas, electricity, waste disposal, etc.).

title: Lion-Feuchtwanger-Straße, Berlin
description:
Modern 2-room apartment in Berlin-Kaulsdorf with balcony, in-house gym, supermarkets (EDEKA & PENNY) within 5 minutes, and direct U5 to Alexanderplatz. Steps from Clara-Zetkin Park, Spree Center, and Stadion Wuhletal — perfect for work–life balance.


How is the commute from here to other locations?
5 min walk → U5 Kaulsdorf-Nord station

20–25 min → Alexanderplatz (direct with U5)

30–40 min → Berlin Hauptbahnhof

35 min by car → Berlin Brandenburg Airport (BER)

35 min by car → Tesla Gigafactory Grünheide

Local convenience: supermarkets, malls, schools, gyms all within walking distance

Does it have parking space?
Yes - secure underground paid parking available, with elevator access straight to your floor. Perfect for car owners.

Why Choose this apartment?
The best of both worlds: calm, green neighborhood + city center just 20 minutes away

Shops & services all around: Spree Center Mall, supermarkets (EDEKA, PENNY, Netto), cafés, gyms within walking distance

Nature & leisure: Kaulsdorfer lakes, Wuhletal paths, Gardens of the World nearby

Family friendly: kindergartens, schools, swimming pool all within a short walk

Future-proof location: direct connections to central Berlin, BER Airport, and Tesla Gigafactory

What's cool about the apartment?
First occupancy – you’ll be the very first tenant

High ceilings & loft-like feel (2.90m)

Elegant floor-to-ceiling windows flooding the rooms with natural light

Spacious open-plan living concept with approx. 2.90 m ceiling height – rare for new builds

Included fitted kitchen with modern appliances

High-quality flooring combined with underfloor heating for comfort

Extra-large doors (approx. 2.50 m) for a premium, loft-like feeling

Balcony/patio with panoramic views into the green surroundings

Bathrooms with branded fixtures & elegant finishes

Practical washing machine space within the apartment

Elevator access for comfort and barrier-free living

Perfectly combines nature and city life: quiet surroundings with fast links to Alexanderplatz & Hauptbahnhof

Overview

Experience true work–life balance in Berlin-Kaulsdorf! Wake up to fresh air from nearby Clara-Zetkin Park, stay fit with a fully equipped gym inside your building, and reach Alexanderplatz in just ~20 minutes via U5. This brand-new, stylish 2-room apartment blends peaceful green surroundings with excellent city connections. Floor-to-ceiling windows, high ceilings, and a balcony create the perfect setting for both productivity and relaxation.

Daily needs are close at hand — Spree Center (shopping, dining, and services), supermarkets (EDEKA & PENNY within 5 minutes’ walk), cafés, gyms, and a swimming pool. Families will appreciate nearby schools and kindergartens, while professionals enjoy fast links to the city center, airport, and even the Tesla Gigafactory. For leisure, explore Stadion Wuhletal (soccer and sports club) or unwind in the famous Gardens of the World just around the corner. Hosting friends or family? title: Am Tierpark, Berlin
description:
Modern Design Apartment with Private Terrace & High-Speed Wi-Fi

Arrive and feel at home from day one. This modern, fully furnished 30 m2 apartment was completed in 2024 and thoughtfully designed to combine comfort, functionality and contemporary living.

Large windows, a private terrace, underfloor heating and fast 250 Mbps Wi-Fi make it an ideal temporary home for professionals, expats and anyone staying in Berlin for a few weeks or several months.

Despite its compact size, the apartment offers everything you need for a comfortable stay: a dedicated workspace, fully equipped kitchen, washing machine, TV and cleverly integrated storage. The modern interior and well-planned layout create a surprisingly spacious and welcoming atmosphere.

One of the apartment’s highlights is the private terrace, extending the living space outdoors and providing a relaxing place to unwind after a day in the city.

With convenient public transport connections, Friedrichshain, Alexanderplatz and other central areas of Berlin are easily accessible.

Simply move in and feel at home: electricity, heating, utilities, high-speed internet and all furnishings are already included in the monthly rent.

title: Mehrower Allee, Berlin
description:
Our place is very well connected with S7 train nearby which is direct one to reach all central spots, also tram stop nearby connecting to the center. Shops are very close, like pharmacies, groceries, post,  few cafes and even an Asian store in the ground floor of our building.

title: Alfred-Kowalke-Straße, Berlin
description:
Welcome to your peaceful home away from home in Berlin! Perfect for expats, remote professionals, or couples relocating to the city, this bright and fully furnished 50m2 ground-floor apartment combines modern living with the rare luxury of a private garden terrace. Available for flexible mid-term stays through spring/summer.

The Apartment:

Living & Dining Area: An open-plan, light-filled living space featuring floor-to-ceiling windows with direct access to your private garden terrace. Relax on the comfortable sofa or enjoy meals at the dining area.

Private Garden Terrace: Step outside to your own green retreat—ideal for morning coffee, dining al fresco, or unwinding after work.

Fully Equipped Kitchen: Ready for cooking from day one. Includes an oven, stove, dishwasher, microwave, large fridge/freezer, coffee machine, and all essential cookware and tableware.

Quiet Bedroom: Designed for rest, featuring a comfortable double bed, spacious wardrobes/storage, and a dedicated workspace setup (desk & ergonomic chair) for comfortable remote work.

Modern Bathroom: Features floor heating, a full bathtub with shower, fresh towels, hairdryer, and in-unit washing machine.

Work & Comfort Essentials

High-speed Wi-Fi throughout the apartment (reaches the terrace!)

Floor heating for cozy winter and spring days

Elevator access & step-free entrance (wheelchair accessible)

Dedicated parking space included upon request

Location & Connectivity
Located in a quiet, modern residential area in Friedrichsfelde (Berlin), you get the best of both worlds: peace and green surroundings, with fast, direct connections to Berlin’s main hubs:

Public Transit: Short walk to U-Bahn and S-Bahn stations.

Transit Times: Under 20 minutes to Ostkreuz and Warschauer Straße (Friedrichshain/Mitte area).

Neighborhood: Grocery stores (REWE, Aldi), pharmacies (Rossmann), and daily amenities are right around the corner.

Rental Details & Support

Utilities Included: Heating, electricity, water, and high-speed internet are fully included.

Official Residence Registration: Full Wohnungsgeberbestätigung provided for smooth registration (Anmeldung).

Flexible Stay: Ideal for mid-term rentals. Perfect fit for corporate stays, project contracts, or temporary relocation.

title: Marie-Elisabeth-von-Humboldt-Straße, Berlin
description:
Behind the modern façade of the building is a high-quality flat with a magical with an enchanting view of the greenery.  

The bright and modern furnished 2-room flat is suitable for max. 1 persons.
The flat is fully furnished (2019). All rooms have underfloor heating.
Large windows with electric external blinds flood the rooms with light.
The apartment is on the 1st floor and can be reached via a staircase (no elevator).

In the open living room there is a leather couch, smart TV and a board.
A fully equipped fitted kitchen, with dining table and chairs, connects to the living room.
In the bedroom there is a double bed (1,80 x 2,00 m), clothes rail and a chest of drawers.
The bathroom has a ground-level shower with towel dryer, washbasin and WC.
In (hidden)ment is the washing machine, iron, ironing board, etc. stored.

The house was completely renovated in 2018. The flat is located on the 2nd floor of the refurbished apartment building on the immediate outskirts of Berlin-(hidden). Situated in a single-family housing estate with a good infrastructure within a radius of 1.4 km. The area is interspersed with meadows and fields. The open Barnimer landscape directly adjoins to the east. 
There is free parking directly in front of the property.

You can get to any destination quickly by public transport. 
You can reach the Ahrensfelde S-Bahn and regional train station in 12 minutes on foot through the park or in 5 minutes by car.  
You can also easily reach a supermarket, pharmacy and doctors in about 10 minutes on foot from the flat.

Landlord confirmation can be issued from a rental period of 6 months.
It is an all-inclusive rent, the tenant has to pay the monthly radio fee directly to the fee service.
 
The offer is aimed at working people with temporary housing needs.

title: Landsberger Allee, Berlin
description:
Beautiful, bright 2-room apartment in Marzahn

This beautiful, modern 2-room apartment in Marzahn offers plenty of light, comfort, and a great location. The apartment is well-maintained, has a shiny, welcoming charm, and is just a 5-minute walk from the M6, M8, and M18 tram lines – perfect for a quick connection to the city center.

Several shopping options are located directly beneath the building, making everyday life especially convenient. Ideal for singles, couples, or anyone looking for a quiet and well-connected neighborhood.

title: Kienbergstraße, Berlin
description:
Step into your new home! This newly renovated, fully furnished 10th-floor apartment offers the perfect blend of modern comfort, incredible convenience, and breathtaking views over Berlin. Ideally designed for a single professional or student, this turnkey solution means you just need to bring your suitcase to start living.

Located on the 10th floor, this unit offers amazing panoramic views and plenty of natural light.

The apartment features a renovated interior with a smart layout, including: 
- a main living/sleeping room including bed, bed-sheet, bed-linen, commode, dining table with 2 chairs, height-adjusted desk with ergonomic chair, armchair with rounded table.

- a separate fully equipped kitchen (including microwave, kettle, toaster, coffee machine, culinary, vacuum), a hallway, and a bathroom with a washing machine.

The building is maintained to a high standard with two elevators and a 24-hour concierge/security service in the lobby, ensuring peace of mind and package reception.

No hidden costs. Your monthly rent covers heating, electricity, and high-speed internet.

This 30 m2 1-room is optimized for one person seeking a high-quality, hassle-free living space.

Unbeatable Location & Connectivity:
Your new home is perfectly situated for both daily necessities and city commuting:
Transportation at Your Doorstep: The Tram/Bus station is located directly in front of the building.

- Take the M8 Tram directly to Berlin Central Station (Hauptbahnhof) without changing lines.

- Just 4 tram stops to S-Bahn Springpfuhl (S7, S75) for quick connections across the city.

- A 7-minute walk gets you to REWE, PENNY, Apotheke (Pharmacy), Action, and Café Steinecke.

- Just a 10-minute walk to the beautiful Gärten der Welt, perfect for jogging, relaxing, or weekend strolls.

title: Kurze Straße, Berlin
description:
Fully furnished and equipped apartment with hardwood floors, a modern built-in kitchen, washing machine, TV, Wi-Fi, etc. The apartment is ready to move into and use immediately. Everything is provided, including bedding, dishes, cutlery, a vacuum cleaner, etc. The full-size bed is large enough for two people. There is also a sofa bed.

The apartment is in a quiet location in a residential area. The “Friedrichsfelde” subway station is nearby and takes you directly to lively Friedrichshain in 10 minutes without changing trains, and to the city center (Alexanderplatz, Hauptbahnhof) in 15 minutes. Several shopping options (REWE, Edeka, Aldi, Rossmann, dm) and the “Tierpark (hidden)” zoo are located in the immediate vicinity.

The building is well-maintained by a professional property management company. Numerous free parking spaces are available in front of the building. The building features a green backyard with an adjacent sports field and running track.

===============================================================================

Komplett möblierte und ausgestattete Wohnung mit Parkettboden, moderner Einbauküche, Waschmaschine, TV, WLAN, usw. Die Wohnung kann sofort bezogen und genutzt werden. Es ist alles vorhanden inklusive Bettwäsche, Geschirr, Besteck, Staubsauger etc. Das vollwertige Bett ist groß genug für zwei Personen. Zusätzlich gibt es ein Schlafsofa.

Die Wohnung hat eine ruhige Lage in einem Wohngebiet. Die U-Bahn-Station „Friedrichsfelde” ist in der Nähe und bringt Sie ohne Umsteigen in 10 Minuten direkt ins lebhafte Friedrichshain und in 15 Minuten ins Stadtzentrum (Alexanderplatz, Hauptbahnhof). Mehrere Einkaufsmöglichkeiten (REWE, Edeka, Aldi, Rossmann, dm) und der Zoo „Tierpark“ befinden sich in unmittelbarer Nähe.

Das Haus wird von einer kompetenten Hausverwaltung gut gepflegt. Vor dem Haus stehen zahlreiche kostenlose Parkplätze zur Verfügung. Das Haus verfügt über einen grünen Hinterhof mit angrenzendem Sportplatz und Laufbahn.

title: Zachertstraße, Berlin
description:
Subletting my 40m2 Altbau apartment in Lichtenberg while I'm away - fully furnished, move-in ready, in a quiet residential building with high ceilings and beautiful original details.

The space:
The living room is the heart of the place with a big, comfy sofa with sleeping function, a soft rug, with a cozy work-from-home desk tucked into a sunny window nook (great light all day). Original wood floors run throughout.The bedroom is built around a solid wood loft bed, with a full built-in wardrobe tucked underneath — so you sleep up top and still get a proper closet and a little reading nook below (there's a vintage armchair down there to enjoy).

The kitchen is a eat-in kitchen: gas stove, a built-in bean-to-cup coffee machine, open shelving, and a dining table under pendant lights - big enough to cook and hang out in. Also good for working.

The bathroom has a tub with a handheld shower, a washing machine, a heated towel rail, and a window for natural light.

The entryway has a coat rack and shoe storage.

Additional note: I have two cats, easygoing and independent, with their own floor-to-ceiling cat tree in the bedroom. Happy to talk through what looking after her while I'm away would involve, or arrange a meet-first.


Interested?

Send me a short note about yourself, and I'll get back to you - happy to arrange a viewing soon!

title: Guntherstraße, Berlin
description:
Attractive 3-Room Attic Apartment with Beautiful Balcony – Long-Term Tenants Preferred

This attractive 3-room apartment offers approximately 72 m2 of well-designed living space with a practical layout and plenty of room for individual living. Located on the top floor, the apartment features two bedrooms, one bathroom, and a spacious living area.

A particular highlight is the beautiful balcony, which provides a lovely outdoor space for relaxing and enjoying warm days while extending the living area outdoors.

The apartment comes with a fully equipped fitted kitchen, providing everything needed for everyday living. Heating is provided efficiently through a combined heat and power plant (Blockheizkraftwerk).

The apartment is available from December 1, 2026. We are particularly looking for reliable tenants interested in a long-term rental arrangement.

The existing furniture and furnishings can either be purchased by the tenants or rented for an additional monthly fee. The details can be discussed and agreed individually.

Long-term subletting is generally possible, subject to prior discussion and approval by the landlord. Registration of residence (Anmeldung) is possible for the subtenant, provided that all legal and contractual requirements are met.

The apartment is ideally suited for couples, small families, or working professionals looking for a comfortable home with good transport connections and a long-term rental perspective.

Features & Details:
•Living / Bedroom: Bright, welcoming, and functionally furnished, ready for immediate move-in.
•Kitchen: Separate fitted kitchen equipped with all essential major electrical appliances; basic crockery is partially provided.
•Bathroom: Modern bathroom with a shower and an innovative ventilation system featuring heat recovery for an optimal indoor climate. A washing machine is there.
•Hallway: Functional entrance area equipped with a practical wardrobe coat rack.
•Apartment Level: Located in the cozy basement (souterrain) of a well-kept, quiet multi-family house.

The rent consists of a monthly basic rent of EUR 396.00 plus a monthly advance payment towards service charges of EUR 200.00. Depending on whether the advance payment towards service charges was sufficient to cover the service charges or not, a pro rata refund or an additional charge for service charges will be made.

The application must be accompanied by a credit report and a statement explaining why the flat is only required on a temporary basis.

Freundliches, frisch renoviertes Apartment zum vorübergehenden Gebrauch für Studenten und Studentinnen in einem gepflegten Mehrfamilienhaus in Berlin-Biesdorf – in bequemer Nähe zur HWR und HTW mit Fußbodenheizung. Die Wohnung besticht durch ihre ruhige, grüne und dennoch verkehrsgünstige Lage. Ein gemeinschaftlicher Fahrradkeller ist vorhanden.
Ausstattung & Details:
•Wohn-/Schlafzimmer:­ Ruhig, freundlich und funktionell möbliert für den direkten Einzug.
•Küche: Separate neue Einbauküche, Geschirr ist teilweise bereits vorhanden.
•Badezimmer: Modernes Bad mit Dusche sowie einem innovativen Lüfter inklusive Wärmerückgewinnung für optimales Raumklima. Waschmaschine ist vorhanden.
•Flur: Funktionaler Eingangsbereich mit praktischer Garderobe.
•Lage im Haus: Das Apartment befindet sich im gemütlichen Souterrain des gepflegten ruhigen Hauses.

Die Miete setzt sich zusammen aus einer monatlichen Kaltmiete in Höhe von 396,00 EUR zzgl. einer monatlichen Betriebskostenvorauszahlung in Höhe von 200,00 EUR. Je nachdem, ob die Betriebskostenvorauszahlung ausreichend für die Abdeckung der Betriebskosten war oder nicht war, kommt es zu einer anteiligen Kostenerstattung bzw. Betriebskostennachforderung.

Der Bewerbung ist eine Schufa-Auskunft und eine Erklärung beizufügen, warum die Wohnung nur für eine Übergangszeit benötigt wird.

title: Einbecker Straße, Berlin
description:
ROOM
Our rooms come fully furnished with everything you need such as a custom-made wardrobe and bed frame including a comfy premium mattress. Depending on size you’ll also have a nightstand and desk in there. If you want to work on that tan, you can get one of the rooms with a private or shared balcony or rooftop terrace overlooking the city.

APARTMENT
The kitchen is fully stocked for any wannabe-chef to get creative in – you’ll have all the pots, pans and knives, as well as a fridge to keep things cool. The dining area is a great space to hang and invite your roomies over for dinner. All apartments entail one or two spacious bathrooms that you’ll be sharing with your flat mates.

PROPERTY
The backyard with its old trees also entails bike stands, lots of greenery to enjoy and one of Berlin’s coolest murals. The building has a big community room with a stunning garden view as well as a dedicated co-working area and lots of space to hang out in.
